structured_output.mechanisms: Time is steps times per-step cost: a fixed launch/optimizer overhead, Muon overhead, and a batch-proportional term made of a small constant plus conv FLOPs (from channel widths) scaled by the resolution curriculum, where low-res steps cost about half. Accuracy rises with effective epochs (steps×batch) and with layer widths. It falls with low-res fraction, cutout, translate4, random flip and label smoothing away from 0.1. Muon adds about 1%.
